title: Operator option in refinementList widget is not working
body:
You can see it in this demo: https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/examples/e-commerce/

Refine by: Material is set to `operator: 'or'` but it combines refinements instead of replacing one with another.

comments.body:
@iapparatus If you want to replace one with another, I believe you may be looking at the menu behaviour instead: https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/menu.html

Let us know how it goes
